nodeGroups.name: Story Acquisition — Active Check
nodeGroups.description: Checks whether this run is resuming an already active story.

nodeGroups.name: Story Acquisition — Select
nodeGroups.description: Selects the next eligible story and gates the empty or blocked queue.

nodeGroups.name: Story Acquisition — Activate
nodeGroups.description: Activates the selected story and stops on a stale or rejected activation.

nodeGroups.name: Story Acquisition — Resume
nodeGroups.description: Carries the existing active story into the pipeline without selecting another.

nodeGroups.name: QA Preparation
nodeGroups.description: Prepares QA and proceeds only when implementation is permitted.

nodeGroups.name: Implementation
nodeGroups.description: Runs Claude through the guarded child workflow and checks its task result.

nodeGroups.name: QA Review
nodeGroups.description: Runs post-implementation QA and continues only on APPROVE.

nodeGroups.name: Evaluation
nodeGroups.description: Runs Evaluator and continues only on COMPLETE.

nodeGroups.name: Final CI
nodeGroups.description: Runs final application CI and continues only on PASSED.

nodeGroups.name: Finalization
nodeGroups.description: Finalizes the story only after every previous stage succeeds.

nodeGroups.name: Pipeline Result — Stopped
nodeGroups.description: Returns the stage, decision, reason, task ID and recovery action when a gate stops.

nodeGroups.name: Pipeline Result — Complete
nodeGroups.description: Returns the concise result after successful finalization.

nodeGroups.name: Publication
nodeGroups.description: Reuses or publishes the validated implementation commit, then gates Final CI.
